close_reason: sc081_validity_cap() implements full SC-081 phased schedule with boundary tests
description:
CA/B Forum Ballot SC-081 introduced phased validity caps:
- 200 days from 2026-03-15 (already in effect as of 2026-05-06)
- 100 days from 2027-03-15
- 47 days from 2029-03-15

The current hard-coded 398-day cap is already incorrect for newly-issued certificates. The policy function needs date-aware logic to select the applicable cap.
title: pkix-profiles: SC-081 phased validity caps not enforced; 398-day cap already stale
